title: Three British Players Win Big at Wrexham Open
summary:
It was a happy day for British tennis fans at the Wrexham Open in Wales. Three British players won their matches and reached the quarter-finals.

Alicia Dudeney played a very long match. It lasted almost three hours! She beat Susan Bandecchi of Switzerland. It was her seventh win in a row.

Hannah Klugman is only 17. She beat Anna Siskova, a player ranked higher than her. Last year, Klugman reached the final of the French Open junior girls' event.

Jodie Burrage also won. She beat Noma Noha Akugue in two sets, and the second set ended in a close tiebreak.

There was a surprise too. The top player in the tournament, Anna Blinkova, lost to Suzan Lamens of the Netherlands.

The quarter-finals are on Friday, the semi-finals on Saturday, and the final on Sunday.
why_it_matters: Seeing a 17-year-old beat higher-ranked players shows young athletes that hard work can pay off.
